title: Hybrid mass spectrometry-AI mapping of proteasome-generated HLA class I epitopes
author: Ri, Saratov, et al.

steps.title: Purify HTBH‑tagged 20S proteasomes
steps.instruction: Obtain highly purified HTBH‑tagged 20S proteasomes from HeLa cells using affinity capture and optional size‑exclusion chromatography.

substeps.instruction: Grow HTBH‑tagged proteasome‑expressing HeLa cells in full DMEM to 90 % confluence in a T75 flask.
Immediately after seeding, treat cells with 500 U/mL IFNγ for 72 h to induce immunosubunits.
Wash cells with 3 mL PBS, add 1 mL lysis buffer, and incubate ~10 min until cells detach.
Collect cell pellets in sterile 2 mL Eppendorf tubes and centrifuge lysates at 20 000 g, 4 °C for 15 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a new sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Wash 20 µL streptavidin agarose resin three times with 1 mL wash buffer 2 (centrifuge 500 g, 3 min each).
Resuspend the resin in 100 µL wash buffer 2 and add it to the supernatant.
Incubate the resin–supernatant mixture at 4 °C with constant rotation at 10 rpm for 16 h.
Wash the resin twice with 1 mL wash buffer 1 (750 mM NaCl); incubate 2 min before each spin (500 g, 3 min).
Wash the resin twice with 1 mL wash buffer 2 (500 g, 3 min).
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the resin in 20 µL wash buffer 2 containing 1 µL TEV protease.
Incubate the resin at 30 °C for 2 h.
Collect the supernatant, which contains the purified proteasomes.
Optional: further purify by size‑exclusion chromatography on a Superose 6 column equilibrated in 20 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 5 mM MgCl₂, and 1 mM TCEP.
Expected yield per T75 flask: ~20 µg constitutive 20S and ~5 µg immune 20S proteasomes.

steps.title: Prepare and run LC‑MS/MS analysis
steps.instruction: Extract peptides from purified proteasomes and analyse them by LC‑MS/MS on an Exploris 480 instrument.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL of each peptide sample with 10 µL loading solution.
Inject 5 µL onto a trap column in trap‑elute mode at a loading flow rate of 10 µL/min.
Separate the peptides on a capillary analytical column.
Elute with a gradient from 5 % solvent B in A to 50 % solvent B over 10 min at 250 nL/min.
Detect peptides in data‑dependent acquisition mode on an Exploris 480 quadrupole‑Orbitrap:
• Set electrospray ionisation voltage to 2 200 V.
• Perform a precursor scan from m/z 350 to 1400 at 60 000 resolution (at 200 m/z).
• Select up to 30 precursors with charge states 2–6 for MS/MS at 15 000 resolution (at 200 m/z).
• Apply a normalized collision energy of 30 %.

steps.title: Compute population immunity index
steps.instruction: Calculate the population protection index for multiple countries using netMHCpan‑4.1 output files.

substeps.instruction: Copy the file data5.csv from the netMHCpan‑4.1 folder into the Coronavirus folder (command: `cp data5.csv ../`).
Run the population‑immunity script to generate data6.csv (27‑country protection index) and data7.csv (per‑peptide index) (command: `cd .././population_immunity.sh`).
